label: AI-reviewed, pending native review
method: Two fresh AI passes, neither a native speaker. Pass 1 back-translated the Tamil into English without seeing the English source and flagged Tamil problems. Pass 2 compared the English source with that back-translation (meaning check), checked that recurring terms are translated consistently, and triaged pass 1 flags. 391 strings were checked; 28 are kept in English by design. Nothing here replaces a native reviewer, and no string was changed because of it.

issues.note: Technical term changed: "claim" (token claims) became a word meaning request; a developer would think this shows request structure, not token claims.
"Abstained" (the system deliberately gave no proposal) became "avoided/skipped", which can read as a step that was omitted or failed.
"Rank" (order of precedence) became a word meaning quality/grade; a higher value could be read as better quality rather than higher precedence.
The word used means an election candidate; "No candidates" for an offer draft is mistranslated.

glossary.recommendation: Use முன்மொழிவு / முன்மொழி throughout so proposal is not confused with பரிந்துரை (referral).
Standardise on the தீர்- root (தீர்க்கப்பட்டது) for resolved status; avoid முடி, which also means hair.
Use one clear term per hold type, identically everywhere (e.g. நிறுத்திவைப்பு for referral holds, தற்காலிக ஒதுக்கீடு for slot holds).
Source says "clinic" in several strings but Tamil uses மருத்துவமனை there and கிளினிக் in shell.clinic; standardise on one.
முடிவு means both decision and search results; use a different word for results (e.g. பொருத்தங்கள்).
